column1: This file was created using the 202609 CRSP database.
It contains value- and equal-weighted returns for  10 prior-return portfolios.
The portfolios are constructed monthly. PRIOR_RET is from -60 to -13.
The annual returns are from January to December.
Missing data are indicated by -99.99 or -999.
